title: Barclays announces share buyback after strong third quarter
body: Barclays said it would launch a new share buyback after third-quarter profit beat expectations, helped by robust trading income at its investment bank.

title: Barclays unveils buyback as quarterly profit beats forecasts
body: Shares in Barclays rose in early trading after the lender reported profit ahead of forecasts and announced a share buyback.

title: Barclays shares jump on buyback and strong trading
body: Barclays shares jumped after the bank paired better than expected results with a fresh buyback programme.

title: Bank of England holds interest rates at September meeting
body: The Bank of England kept interest rates unchanged, with the Monetary Policy Committee split on whether inflation had eased enough to allow a rate cut.

title: BoE leaves interest rates unchanged in split vote
body: Policymakers at the Bank of England voted to hold interest rates, leaving mortgage lenders waiting for a cut.

title: Bank of England holds interest rates as MPC splits
body: The Bank of England held interest rates; the MPC split over the outlook, a mixed signal for banks and mortgage borrowers.

title: BP issues profit warning as refining margins slump
body: BP warned that third-quarter profit would be weaker than expected after refining margins slumped and oil prices fell.

title: BP profit warning hits shares after refining slump
body: Shares in BP fell after the energy group issued a profit warning, blaming a slump in refining margins.

title: AstraZeneca wins MHRA approval for new cancer drug
body: AstraZeneca said the MHRA approved its new cancer drug for use in the UK, a boost for the drugmaker's oncology pipeline.

title: MHRA approves AstraZeneca cancer drug
body: The UK medicines regulator approved a new AstraZeneca cancer drug, which the company said strengthens its growth outlook.

title: Tesco and Sainsbury's cut prices as supermarket price war returns
body: Tesco and Sainsbury's announced price cuts on hundreds of grocery lines, raising fears of a margin squeeze for supermarkets.

title: Supermarket price war: Tesco and Sainsbury's cut grocery prices
body: Britain's two biggest supermarkets, Tesco and Sainsbury's, cut grocery prices, a move analysts warned could weaken retail margins.

title: Rolls-Royce wins major jet engine order
body: Rolls-Royce won a large order for its jet engines from an international airline, a boost for its aerospace recovery.

title: Rolls-Royce shares rise after jet engine order win
body: Shares in Rolls-Royce rose after the engineer won a major jet engine order.

title: Vodafone outage leaves customers without mobile network
body: Vodafone said engineers were working to fix a nationwide outage that left customers without access to its mobile network for several hours.

title: Vodafone mobile network outage hits customers nationwide
body: A Vodafone network outage hit customers across the UK; Ofcom said it was monitoring the situation.

title: FCA fines Lloyds over complaint handling failures
body: The Financial Conduct Authority fined Lloyds Banking Group for failures in how it handled customer complaints.

title: Lloyds fined by FCA for complaint handling failures
body: Lloyds was fined by the FCA, which said the bank failed to treat complaining customers fairly.

title: Shell raises dividend and extends buyback
body: Shell raised its quarterly dividend and extended its share buyback, saying cash flow remained resilient despite lower oil prices.

title: Unilever announces job cuts in restructuring plan
body: Unilever announced job cuts as part of a restructuring of its household brands division.

title: BAE Systems wins defence contract for naval vessels
body: BAE Systems won a multi-year defence contract to build naval support vessels, adding to a record order backlog.

title: HSBC expands wealth management business in Asia
body: HSBC said it would expand its wealth management business in Asia, hiring advisers in Hong Kong and Singapore.

title: Ofgem lowers energy price cap for winter
body: Ofgem lowered the energy price cap for the winter quarter after wholesale gas prices fell.

title: BT accelerates full-fibre broadband rollout
body: BT Group said it would accelerate its full-fibre broadband rollout, aiming to reach more rural homes next year.

title: Bank of England holds interest rates again in October
body: The Bank of England held interest rates for a second month, with the MPC saying it needed more evidence that inflation was falling.
